title: Research-engine measured localization matrix v2
principle: Localize deterministic transport, parsing, provenance, accounting, and measured specialized-model residuals; retain authoritative-PDF semantic hydration and remote semantic reasoning unless a controlled benchmark demonstrates equivalent quality with a material resource or allowance benefit.
global_invariants: The original PDF/source artifact remains scientific authority.
Paper-package.v1 is a derived/cache/benchmark representation and MUST NOT replace authoritative-PDF hydration for production EXTRACT or VERIFY.
EXTRACT and VERIFY remain STANDARD semantic jobs over authoritative-PDF context.
VERIFY remains radius-0 cited-page hydration unless separately revalidated.
Local heavyweight document models are shared process owners with bounded per-family queues; duplicate per-worker model ownership is forbidden.
OCR, general document VLM, chart VLM, embeddings, reranking, and local semantic replacements remain disabled/deferred unless a measured residual or benchmark justifies them.
Sustained research remains disabled until production acceptance and licensing gates are complete.

job_type_decisions.rationale: Nine-paper A/B rejected paper-package context as a wholesale replacement: all three contemporaneous controlled EXTRACT pairs differed materially while controlled input-token savings were negligible overall.

Production routing is intentionally narrower than all VERIFY: only exact one-page bounded jobs use Qwen as primary; ineligible, backpressured, runtime-failed, or guard-failed jobs fall through to Codex STANDARD.
Already implemented by DeterministicResearchExecutor with no semantic reasoning requirement.

Used for measured A/B, model usage, concurrency and operational state.

fallback_policy: Authoritative PDF/page/region is always the scientific fallback.
If specialized formula/table local inference fails, do not silently invent structure; retain/return authoritative PDF context and route to explicit semantic/human escalation.
If deterministic source acquisition cannot support a provider, fail closed with unsupported-provider semantics rather than fabricating source state.
If VERIFY cited pages are unavailable, fail closed with MISSING_VERIFICATION_SOURCE_PAGE.
If a future local semantic candidate is proposed for SCREEN/EXTRACT/VERIFY, require a controlled quality benchmark and material resource/allowance benefit before changing JOB_TIERS.
